name: IDEAL Internet
summary: Macarthur region (SW Sydney) ISP, 'Macarthur's oldest internet service provider'; owner Darren Worley; company sold EoFY 2006 (owner retained the domain) (IDEAL ORGANISATION PTY LIMITED, ACN 086 119 753).

events.details: Ran as a private dialup entity from mid 1994; officially launched commercial services 1 July 1995 (per owner Darren Worley).
Company (IDEAL Internet Pty Ltd) sold end of financial year 2006; owner retained *.au domain and phone numbers.
